test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: general
question: A circle is inscribed in ΔPQR touching the sides QR, PR and PQ at the points S, U and T, respectively. PQ = (QR + 5)cm, PQ = (PR + 2)cm. If the perimeter of ΔPQR is 32 cm, then PR is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **PR** = x cm.

Given: **PQ** = PR + 2 = (x + 2) cm.

And **PQ** = QR + 5 ⇒ **QR** = PQ − 5 = (x + 2) − 5 = (x − 3) cm.

Perimeter = **PQ + QR + PR** = 32 cm.

⇒ (x + 2) + (x − 3) + x = 32 ⇒ 3x − 1 = 32 ⇒ 3x = 33 ⇒ x = 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ed16bba2ddf71c897ce052839829a4fdfe4b01c29e6701f2edb53ad7dacee0b.png] 

Let the side lengths be **PQ** = c, **QR** = a, and **PR** = b.

According to the question:

1. c = a + 5 ⇒ a = c − 5

2. c = b + 2 ⇒ b = c − 2

The **perimeter** of the triangle is given as 32 cm:

⇒ a + b + c = 32

Substitute the values of a and b in terms of c:

⇒ (c − 5) + (c − 2) + c = 32

⇒ 3c − 7 = 32

⇒ 3c = 39

⇒ c = 13 cm

Now, calculate **PR (b)**:

⇒ b = c − 2 = 13 − 2 = 11 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 11 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Tangents from an External Point

Lengths of tangents drawn from an **external point** to a circle are equal. In this triangle, **QT = QS**, **RS = RU**, and **PT = PU**.

Incircle Property

The distance from a vertex to the points of tangency can be calculated as **s − opposite side**, where **s** is the semi-perimeter. For example, **PT = PU = s − a**.

Incenter

The center of the **inscribed circle (I)** is the point where the **internal angle bisectors** of the triangle intersect.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 cm.**</p
